column1: # Declared arms of a perception iteration: one line per arm, the arm name, a tab, then the
# swaps that run_perception_iteration.sh and run_dev_b.sh pass as --set on every physverify call
# Every arm runs the committed profile otherwise, so arms that share a provider prefix share its
# cache keys and error-profile entries. k: vda_large depth with the line-of-sight R5a and R5b
# variants and the R5a tau in their unit (scripts/h200/README.md). r3a-ip-h: the precise profile
# with R3a read from the image-plane apex heights (the image_apex variant).
